items.quote: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said unto him, What hast thou done unto us?
items.claim: Abimelech called Abraham and questioned what wrongdoing he had committed

items.quote: thou hast brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin
items.claim: Abraham brought a great sin upon Abimelech and his kingdom

items.quote: thou hast done deeds unto me that ought not to be done
items.claim: Abraham committed deeds against Abimelech that were improper
Abimelech questions what offense he has committed against Abraham
